name: NexNotch — Dynamic Island for GNOME
description: Dynamic Island for GNOME 46+. A MacBook-notch-style pill replaces the top clock and expands on hover into a swipeable hub: music player with album art and synced lyrics, notification history, live system monitor, Google Calendar via GOA, dual-city weather, Pomodoro timer, notes, Claude Code usage, GNOME quick settings, plus in-notch volume/brightness, charger, drink-water and notification peeks. Built by NexVar.
